text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I am truly humbled to 
receive birthday wishes from both of you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all...! I've prepared a present 
and a bouquet, so please, accept them."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's not just about the presents, 
right? I'm planning to throw a birthday 
party and record a celebratory video to 
commemorate it too~☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-No way. You really didn't have to 
go that far...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't be like that♪ It's your 
special birthday, so let everyone 
celebrate in style!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Or are you not a fan of videos...? I 
thought it'd make for a nice keepsake, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...No. If you're willing to go that far—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fitting for a celebration... I need to 
make sure the room is properly decorated, 
too. And prepare all the dishes everyone 
likes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Let's make a centerpiece 
arrangement for the table, too. Balancing 
with the other decorations, the colors 
should be—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're actually that down to join 
in?! That's our Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's going to be a wonderful 
party...! I have to capture every 
important moment on video!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Since we're receiving everyone's 
kindness— I want to make it something 
everyone can enjoy.
